headline: Rossi leads at home
story: From third on the grid, Rossi takes the lead on the first lap in front of his fans. Capirossi, who started second, drops to eighth.

headline: Fastest lap of the race
story: Seventh and 1.75 seconds behind Rossi, Capirossi sets the fastest lap of the race, 1'50.195. His charge has begun.

headline: Capirossi's charge
story: Lap after lap, Capirossi climbs to third and cuts the gap to Rossi from 2 seconds to 0.3.
source: lap chart; laps (gap 1.954 s on lap 10, 0.310 s on lap 13); broadcast 32-40m

headline: Rossi runs wide
story: Into San Donato Rossi runs wide and almost stops. Four riders go past: from first to fifth. Capirossi takes the lead.

headline: The comeback
story: Rossi fights back past Gibernau, Melandri and Hayden. At Arrabbiata he is second again, right behind Capirossi.

headline: Two thousandths
story: Rossi takes the lead, Capirossi takes it back. They cross the line 0.002 seconds apart.

headline: Victory at San Donato
story: Last lap: Capirossi runs wide at San Donato, the corner where Rossi lost the lead. Rossi goes through and wins by 0.575 seconds.
